pathway.description: A: schizophrenia, B: substance abuse, D: unemployment, E: chronic homelessness. Collapsing C (social support loss) into B->D edge.

_rationale: P(D|B)=0.20: substance use disorders increase unemployment risk. Literature suggests 15-25% unemployment among people with SUD (Compton et al. 2014, Henkel 2011). This is a trivariate abstraction, collapsing social support loss (C).
